traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Paracryphiaceae: leaves whorled; leaves simple; margins serrate; veins pinnate; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite or polygamous; ovary superior; stems woody; flowers in panicles; perianth tepals; fruit capsule or follicle; stamens 8 (-11); carpels 8 to 15. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
